cm:stacks:bulk-assets.description: Bulk operations for assets: publish/unpublish/cross-publish (CMS) and delete/move (CS Assets). Delete/move load asset UIDs from a JSON file `{ "uids": [...] }`; pass organization via `--org-uid`.
examples: <%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation publish --environments dev,staging --locales en-us -k blt123
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation unpublish --environments prod --locales en-us -a myAlias
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation publish --folder-uid cs_root --environments prod --locales en-us -k blt123
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation publish --environments prod --locales en-us --publish-mode bulk -k blt123
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation publish --source-env production --source-alias prod-delivery --environments staging,dev --locales en-us -a myAlias
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation delete --space-uid am123 --org-uid bltOrg --locale en-us --asset-uids-file ./assets.json
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --operation move --space-uid am123 --org-uid bltOrg --target-folder-uid amFolder --asset-uids-file ./assets.json

alias.description: Uses the name of a saved Management Token to authenticate the command. The command can only access the branches allowed for that token. This option can be used as an alternative to` --stack-api-key.`

stack-api-key.description: API key of the source stack. You must use either the --stack-api-key flag or the --alias flag.

operation.description: Operation to perform: `publish`/`unpublish` (CMS, requires stack API key or alias) or `delete`/`move` (CS Assets, requires OAuth/Token and --space-uid/--org-uid)
operation.notes: One of: publish, unpublish, delete, move

environments.description: Specifies one or more environments where the entries or assets should be published. Separate multiple environments with spaces.

locales.description: Specifies one or more locale codes for which the entries or assets should be published. Separate multiple locales with spaces.

source-alias.description: Alias name for source environment delivery token (required for cross-publish). Add delivery token using: csdx auth:tokens:add

publish-mode.description: Publish mode: bulk (uses Bulk Publish API) or single (individual API calls)

branch.description: The name of the branch where you want to perform the bulk publish operation. If you don't mention the branch name, then by default the content from main branch will be published.

config.description: (optional) Specifies the path to a JSON configuration file that defines the options for the command. Use this file instead of passing multiple CLI flags for a single run.

yes.description: Skips interactive confirmation prompts and runs the command immediately using the provided options. Useful for automation and scripts.

retry-failed.description: (optional) Use this option to retry publishing the failed entries/assets from the logfile. Specify the name of the logfile that lists failed publish calls. If this option is used, it will override all other flags.

revert.description: (optional) Revert publish operations from a log folder. Specify the folder path containing success logs. Works similar to retry-failed.

bulk-operation-file.description: (optional) Folder path to store operation logs. Creates separate files for success and failed operations. Default: bulk-operation

folder-uid.description: (optional) The UID of the Assets' folder from which the assets need to be published. The default value is cs_root.

data-dir.description: Path to exported content folder containing asset publish details.

dry-run.description: Preview the publish plan without making any API calls.

org-uid.description: Organization UID for CS Assets API (organization_uid header)

workspace.description: CS Assets workspace query parameter (default: main)

asset-uids-file.description: Path to UTF-8 JSON file: exactly `{ "uids": ["uid1", "uid2"] }` (non-empty string array, no trimming; large lists: see docs for NODE_OPTIONS)

locale.description: Locale code for bulk delete only (single locale per run). Not applicable for move — move always relocates all locale variants of an asset.

target-folder-uid.description: Destination CS Assets folder UID for bulk move. Use "root" to move assets to the root folder.

workspace.description: Migration workspace root for migration-manifest.json (defaults to --output)

migrate:import.description: Import a Contentstack bundle — into an existing stack (--stack-api-key) or a new one created in an organization (--org)
examples: $ csdx migrate:import -d ./contentstack-import/bundle   # prompts for org, creates a stack

stack-api-key.description: Destination stack API key (import into an EXISTING stack)

org.description: Destination organization uid — create a new stack here and import into it (used when --stack-api-key is omitted; prompts with a list if omitted)

stack-name.description: Name for the new stack (default: "Contentful Migration <date>")

data-dir.description: Path to convert output bundle directory

migrate:status.description: Show migration manifest and step status

stack-api-key.description: Use this flag to add the API key of your stack. You must use either the --stack-api-key flag or the --alias flag.

alias.description: Use this flag to add the management token alias. You must use either the --alias flag or the --stack-api-key flag.

file-path.description: Use this flag to provide the path of the file of the migration script.

branch.description: Use this flag to add the branch name where you want to perform the migration. (target branch name)

config.description: [optional] Path of the JSON configuration file.

inline-config.description: [optional] Inline configuration, <key1>:<value1>. Passing an external configuration makes the script re-usable.

multiple.description: This flag helps you to migrate multiple content files in a single instance. Mention the folder path where your migration script files are stored.
